items.item: The page header has a plural title and at most one primary action; other actions such as export sit in a secondary position
items.evidence: Title is the singular-looking noun "Equipment" (h1 in equipment-list.tsx); equipment is a mass noun, not a plural like "Machines". One primary action (Add equipment, default variant) with Export as outline secondary; audit headerPrimaryActions=1. Plural-title requirement is not met literally.

items.item: The table appears in the first viewport, with search and 2–3 visible filters (such as location and status) and no row of KPI cards above it
items.evidence: Screenshot: table starts at y=205 (audit firstTableTop 205) with ~17 rows visible; search input, Location select and Next inspection select, plus status tabs; no KPI cards.

items.item: By default the list is ordered with overdue inspections first, then inspections due soon, then the rest
items.evidence: compareMachines with sortField null sorts by URGENCY_RANK[urgencyOf] then nextInspection; screenshot shows Overdue 33 days ... Overdue 3 days, Due today, Due in 1 day ... ascending; summary line says "Overdue and due soon first".

items.item: Overdue and due-soon inspections are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 7 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: InspectionBadge in status-badge.tsx renders "Overdue N days", "Due today", "Due in N days" with an icon plus tone.

items.item: Dates are absolute and consistently formatted, and every row has a human-readable equipment code
items.evidence: formatDate (en-GB, 2-digit day, short month) used for both date columns, e.g. "03 Oct 2026" (en-GB renders "Sept" for September, still consistent); Asset ID column shows EQ-1053 etc.

items.item: Status tabs or a summary line show counts (such as "Overdue 4")
items.evidence: Tabs "All 40, Operational 29, Idle 3, Under maintenance 4, Down 4" and summary line "40 machines · 6 inspections overdue".

items.item: Rows are single-line, and row actions show at most two visible controls, with icon-only controls having accessible names
items.evidence: Audit rows single=25, double=0, height 40px; each row has only a kebab DropdownMenuTrigger with aria-label "Actions for machine EQ-..." (plus a labelled checkbox).

items.item: A filter combination with no matches shows a no-results state with a clear-filters action, distinct from the first-use empty state; a loading state and an error state with retry are present
items.evidence: StateRow variants: "No equipment matches these filters" with Clear filters button; "No equipment yet" with Add equipment (first-use); SkeletonRows loading; "Couldn't load equipment" with Retry button.

items.item: Interactive targets are at least 24×24px, and text and status contrast meets 4.5:1
items.evidence: Audit smallTargets=0 of 66 and contrast checked 208, no text-contrast violations; badge tones are -800/-900 text on -50 backgrounds.

notes: Audit score 90; only violation is radius-scale (Export button 10px, 4 radii 4/6/8/10). Rendered font is Times New Roman fallback (no sans font loaded), which looks unpolished but is not a listed tell. Status badges use pill radius and four tones (green/slate/blue/red) plus amber for due soon, which is semantic and each carries text plus icon, so not counted as rainbow-status. A dev-tool 'Compiling' indicator is visible in the screenshot (environment artifact). No greeting, KPI tiles, gradients, glass, emoji, avatars, or hover-lift seen.
